import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from catboost import CatBoostRegressor
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Create submission directory
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Target columns
target_cols = ["formation_energy_ev_natom", "bandgap_energy_ev"]

# Feature columns (excluding id and targets)
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in target_cols + ["id"]]

# Identify categorical feature
cat_features = ["spacegroup"]
cat_indices = [feature_cols.index(cat) for cat in cat_features]

# Prepare training data
X_train_full = train_df[feature_cols].copy()
y_train_full = train_df[target_cols].copy()

# Split for validation (80/20)
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y_train_full, test_size=0.2, random_state=42
)

# Prepare test data
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].copy()

# Train and evaluate models for each target
models = {}
val_predictions = {}

for target in target_cols:
    model = CatBoostRegressor(
        iterations=500,
        depth=6,
        learning_rate=0.1,
        loss_function="RMSE",
        verbose=0,
        cat_features=cat_indices,
        random_state=42,
    )
    model.fit(X_train, y_train[target], cat_features=cat_indices)
    models[target] = model

    val_pred = model.predict(X_val)
    val_predictions[target] = val_pred

# Calculate validation metric (mean-column-wise RMSLE)
rmsle_scores = []
for target in target_cols:
    val_true = y_val[target].values
    val_pred = val_predictions[target]
    rmsle = np.sqrt(np.mean((np.log1p(val_pred) - np.log1p(val_true)) ** 2))
    rmsle_scores.append(rmsle)

mean_rmsle = np.mean(rmsle_scores)
print(f"Validation Mean Column-wise RMSLE: {mean_rmsle}")

# Retrain on full training data for final predictions
for target in target_cols:
    model = CatBoostRegressor(
        iterations=500,
        depth=6,
        learning_rate=0.1,
        loss_function="RMSE",
        verbose=0,
        cat_features=cat_indices,
        random_state=42,
    )
    model.fit(X_train_full, y_train_full[target], cat_features=cat_indices)
    models[target] = model

# Generate test predictions
test_predictions = {}
for target in target_cols:
    test_predictions[target] = models[target].predict(X_test)

# Create submission file
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_df["id"],
        "formation_energy_ev_natom": test_predictions["formation_energy_ev_natom"],
        "bandgap_energy_ev": test_predictions["bandgap_energy_ev"],
    }
)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
